status: Reject as ready-made function-object cache implementation; no closed minimum end-to-end implementation established by this review. EH parsing/edge algorithms are reusable components.

evidence.finding: One LinkGraph Block per input section; STT_FUNC is a symbol inside that block. Shared .text is not automatically split into function products.
Default passes split .eh_frame records, fix EH edges, add terminator, mark live (default all symbols), build GOT/stubs, allocate, optimize and apply fixups. This is a JIT memory-link pipeline.

Existing PC-begin relocation returns its Target symbol without applying Addend to choose the function owner; keepalive is added from Target block to FDE. Splitting .text without first normalizing section-symbol+function-offset references can attach a later function FDE to the wrong block.
splitBlock expressly does not repair incoming edges whose target-plus-addend crosses a split boundary, and requires clients to repair ordinals.
Symbol conversion merges STV_DEFAULT/STV_PROTECTED and STB_WEAK/STB_GNU_UNIQUE cases; graph alone is not a lossless relocatable ELF representation.
Section stores name/protection/lifetime/ordinal rather than complete ELF header fields; context reports FinalizedAlloc memory, not a relocatable-object buffer writer.
Graph borrows the underlying object buffer. Keeping only a bounded immutable byte buffer avoids old LLVMContext/TM/MF owners; keeping the graph itself reintroduces graph allocation accounting.

Original emission retains alignment/max-padding constraints as fragments. Function bytes moved to a different start residue may require different internal block padding and branch relaxation; raw input/pipeline equality alone does not bind layout phase.

required_but_not_implemented: Complete function slicing and cross-slice relocation ownership, with normalized section-symbol/addend targets
Current function order, symbol identity/ordinal, exact ELF section flags/alignment and symbol-table rebuilding
Original CIE/FDE records, current PC-begin/range and CIE-offset updates with no stale .eh_frame retention
Current layout dependency guard or relocation/relaxation-capable fragment representation
Relocatable ELF writer/combiner preserving current object-level metadata and original linker path
Sound machine-work skipping boundary and immutable-byte producer verification/binding contract
performance_boundary: Could remove some typed snapshot capture cost and avoid later machine/AP work for admitted functions, but parsing/slicing/writer/layout costs are unmeasured. Reported cold MIR capture 295ms and warm original-AP opportunity about40ms are gross observations, not proved savings.
decision: Do not start a broad JITLink rewrite based on existing pruning/EH utilities. Preserve this negative result; root selected a separate bounded late post-O2 dead-definition investigation.
